problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate the distribution of a certain commodity from a collection of manufacturing centers to a network of regional warehouses, with the objective of minimizing the aggregate expenditure on freight.

The inventory available for dispatch at each manufacturing center is precisely quantified as follows:  
*Center Alpha maintains a stockpile of 167 units.  
*Center Beta has 89 units on hand.  
*Center Gamma possesses 161 units.  
*Center Delta holds 95 units.  
*Center Epsilon can provide 183 units.

The requisite intake at each regional warehouse, which must be satisfied in full, is delineated below:  
*Warehouse X requires a delivery of 70 units.  
*Warehouse Y must receive 208 units.  
*Warehouse Z has a need for 138 units.  
*Warehouse W is slated for 124 units.  
*Warehouse V demands 111 units.

The freight cost per unit for each possible route linking a manufacturing center to a warehouse is provided in the accompanying table:

| Origin / Destination | Warehouse X | Warehouse Y | Warehouse Z | Warehouse W | Warehouse V |
|----------------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|
| Center Alpha         | 19          | 9           | 11          | 8           | 3           |
| Center Beta          | 9           | 15          | 8           | 15          | 19          |
| Center Gamma         | 20          | 13          | 11          | 1           | 16          |
| Center Delta         | 11          | 6           | 16          | 7           | 12          |
| Center Epsilon       | 9           | 11          | 9           | 20          | 9           |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the minimal total freight expenditure.
